_meta.title: Type-A Signal/Observability KG for Kubernetes
_meta.source: inventory.xlsx + research from Anthropic deep-research task

nodes.name: kubelet runtime family (~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_running_pods, kubelet_running_containers, kubelet_started_pods_total, kubelet_active_pods, kubelet_node_name. Requires bearer token + TLS.

nodes.name: kubelet pod lifecycle latency (~10 histograms)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds, kubelet_pod_worker_duration_seconds, kubelet_pleg_relist_duration_seconds, kubelet_pleg_relist_interval_seconds, kubelet_pod_worker_start_duration_seconds.

nodes.name: kubelet_runtime_operations_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_runtime_operations_total, kubelet_runtime_operations_duration_seconds, kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total. operation_type=pull_image/exec_sync/container_status/etc.

nodes.name: kubelet evictions family (~4 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_evictions, kubelet_eviction_stats_age_seconds. Labels signal=memory.available/nodefs.available/imagefs.available/pid.available.

nodes.name: kubelet_volume_manager_* (~3 metrics) — full enumeration in Storage sheet
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Storage sheet.

nodes.name: kubelet_certificate_manager_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_certificate_manager_client_ttl_seconds, kubelet_certificate_manager_server_rotation_age_seconds, kubelet_certificate_manager_client_expiration_renew_errors.

nodes.name: kubelet lifecycle latencies (~10 histograms)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_cgroup_manager_duration_seconds, kubelet_pod_status_sync_duration_seconds, kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds, kubelet_node_startup_duration_seconds.

nodes.name: kubelet HTTP server (~5 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kubelet_http_requests_total, kubelet_http_requests_duration_seconds, kubelet_http_inflight_requests, kubelet_lifecycle_handler_http_fallbacks_total.

nodes.name: prober_probe_* (liveness/readiness/startup probes — ~6 metrics)
nodes.granularity: Per pod, per container, per probe_type
nodes.notes: Examples: prober_probe_total, prober_probe_duration_seconds. probe_type=liveness/readiness/startup.

nodes.name: kubelet resource endpoint (~5 metrics)
nodes.granularity: Per pod, per container, per node
nodes.notes: Lightweight metrics for Resource Metrics API. Examples: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total, container_memory_working_set_bytes, node_cpu_usage_seconds_total, node_memory_working_set_bytes, container_start_time_seconds.

nodes.name: container_cpu_* family (~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total, container_cpu_user_seconds_total, container_cpu_system_seconds_total, container_cpu_cfs_periods_total, container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total, container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total, container_cpu_load_average_10s. Throttling family critical for CPU starvation.

nodes.name: container_memory_* family (~14 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: container_memory_usage_bytes, container_memory_working_set_bytes, container_memory_rss, container_memory_cache, container_memory_swap, container_memory_failcnt, container_memory_failures_total (type=pgfault/pgmajfault), container_memory_max_usage_bytes, container_memory_kernel_usage.

nodes.name: container_network_* (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.notes: See Network sheet for individually enumerated rows.

nodes.name: container_fs_* / container_blkio_* (full enumeration in Storage sheet)
nodes.notes: See Storage sheet for individually enumerated rows.

nodes.name: container_oom_events_total / container_processes / container_threads (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: container_oom_events_total, container_processes, container_threads, container_threads_max, container_sockets, container_file_descriptors. OOM counter critical for memory analysis.

nodes.name: container_start_time_seconds / container_spec_* (~5 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: container_start_time_seconds, container_last_seen, container_tasks_state, container_spec_cpu_shares, container_spec_cpu_quota, container_spec_memory_limit_bytes.

nodes.name: machine_* family (~8 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: machine_cpu_cores, machine_cpu_physical_cores, machine_cpu_sockets, machine_memory_bytes, machine_swap_bytes, machine_scrape_error.

nodes.name: apiserver_request_* family (~8 metrics)
nodes.granularity: Per verb, per resource, per code
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_request_total, apiserver_request_duration_seconds, apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds, apiserver_request_terminations_total, apiserver_request_aborts_total, apiserver_response_sizes.

nodes.name: apiserver_admission_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_admission_controller_admission_duration_seconds, apiserver_admission_webhook_admission_duration_seconds, apiserver_admission_webhook_request_total, apiserver_admission_webhook_rejection_count, apiserver_admission_step_admission_duration_seconds.

nodes.name: apiserver_audit_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_audit_event_total, apiserver_audit_requests_rejected_total, apiserver_audit_level_total, apiserver_audit_error_total. Requires audit-policy-file flag.

nodes.name: apiserver_storage_* / etcd_* via apiserver (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_storage_objects, apiserver_storage_db_total_size_in_bytes, apiserver_storage_list_duration_seconds, apiserver_storage_list_evaluated_objects_total, etcd_request_duration_seconds, apiserver_watch_events_total.

nodes.name: apiserver_flowcontrol_* (Priority & Fairness — ~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_flowcontrol_dispatched_requests_total, apiserver_flowcontrol_rejected_requests_total, apiserver_flowcontrol_request_concurrency_in_use, apiserver_flowcontrol_request_wait_duration_seconds, apiserver_flowcontrol_current_inqueue_requests.

nodes.name: apiserver_longrunning_requests / inflight (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: apiserver_longrunning_requests, apiserver_current_inflight_requests, apiserver_current_inqueue_requests, apiserver_init_events_total, apiserver_watch_cache_events_dispatched_total.

nodes.name: etcd_server_* (~15 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: etcd_server_has_leader, etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total, etcd_server_proposals_committed_total, etcd_server_proposals_applied_total, etcd_server_proposals_pending, etcd_server_proposals_failed_total, etcd_server_slow_apply_total.

nodes.name: etcd_disk_* / etcd_wal_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds, etcd_disk_backend_commit_duration_seconds, etcd_disk_backend_defrag_duration_seconds, etcd_disk_backend_snapshot_duration_seconds, etcd_wal_write_bytes_total. fsync >100ms = disk pain.

nodes.name: etcd_network_* (~6 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: etcd_network_peer_round_trip_time_seconds, etcd_network_peer_sent_bytes_total, etcd_network_peer_received_bytes_total, etcd_network_client_grpc_received_bytes_total, etcd_network_client_grpc_sent_bytes_total.

nodes.name: etcd_mvcc_* (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes, etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_use_in_bytes, etcd_mvcc_put_total, etcd_mvcc_delete_total, etcd_mvcc_range_total, etcd_mvcc_txn_total. K3s: embedded SQLite by default — no etcd metrics; with --cluster-init etcd metrics appear.

nodes.name: scheduler_* (~14 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: scheduler_pending_pods, scheduler_pod_scheduling_attempts, scheduler_pod_scheduling_duration_seconds, scheduler_unschedulable_pods, scheduler_schedule_attempts_total, scheduler_framework_extension_point_duration_seconds, scheduler_preemption_attempts_total, scheduler_preemption_victims.

nodes.name: controller_manager_* / workqueue_* (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: workqueue_depth, workqueue_adds_total, workqueue_queue_duration_seconds, workqueue_work_duration_seconds, workqueue_unfinished_work_seconds, workqueue_longest_running_processor_seconds, workqueue_retries_total, leader_election_master_status.

nodes.name: node_collector_* (~5 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_collector_evictions_total, node_collector_unhealthy_nodes_in_zone, node_collector_zone_size, node_collector_zone_health, node_collector_update_node_health_duration_seconds.

nodes.name: kubeproxy_* family (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Network sheet. Cilium kube-proxy replacement obviates this.

nodes.name: coredns_* family (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.granularity: Per server, per zone, per type
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Network sheet.

nodes.name: containerd_* family (~30 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: containerd_grpc_server_started_total, containerd_grpc_server_handled_total, containerd_grpc_server_handling_seconds, containerd_build_info, container_blkio_*. Disabled by default — set address in config.toml.

nodes.name: node_cpu_* family (~6 metrics)
nodes.granularity: Per node, per cpu, per mode
nodes.notes: Examples: node_cpu_seconds_total (mode=user/system/iowait/idle/steal/...), node_cpu_guest_seconds_total, node_cpu_frequency_hertz, node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz, node_cpu_core_throttles_total.

nodes.name: node_load1 / load5 / load15 / boot_time (~5 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_load1, node_load5, node_load15, node_uname_info, node_boot_time_seconds.

nodes.name: node_memory_* family (~50 metrics from /proc/meminfo)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_memory_MemTotal_bytes, node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, node_memory_MemFree_bytes, node_memory_Buffers_bytes, node_memory_Cached_bytes, node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes, node_memory_SwapFree_bytes, node_memory_AnonPages_bytes, node_memory_Slab_bytes, node_memory_Dirty_bytes, node_memory_Writeback_bytes, node_memory_HugePages_*, node_memory_KernelStack_bytes.

nodes.name: node_vmstat_* family (~30 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_vmstat_pgfault, node_vmstat_pgmajfault, node_vmstat_pswpin, node_vmstat_pswpout, node_vmstat_oom_kill, node_vmstat_pgsteal_kswapd, node_vmstat_pgsteal_direct, node_vmstat_pgscan_kswapd, node_vmstat_compact_stall.

nodes.name: node_pressure_* (PSI — ~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total, node_pressure_cpu_stalled_seconds_total, node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total, node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total, node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total, node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total. Strong saturation signal.

nodes.name: node_disk_* / node_filesystem_* (full enumeration in Storage sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Storage sheet.

nodes.name: node_network_* / node_netstat_* / node_sockstat_* / node_nf_conntrack_* (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Network sheet.

nodes.name: node_filefd_* / node_processes_* / node_entropy_* (~15 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_filefd_allocated, node_filefd_maximum, node_processes_pids, node_processes_max_processes, node_processes_state, node_processes_threads, node_entropy_available_bits, node_entropy_pool_size_bits.

nodes.name: node_systemd_* (~10 metrics, optional collector)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_systemd_unit_state, node_systemd_units, node_systemd_socket_accepted_connections_total, node_systemd_timer_last_trigger_seconds.

nodes.name: node_hwmon_* / node_thermal_zone_temp (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_hwmon_temp_celsius, node_hwmon_temp_max_celsius, node_thermal_zone_temp, node_hwmon_fan_rpm, node_hwmon_power_average_watts.

nodes.name: node_time_seconds / node_timex_* (~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_time_seconds, node_timex_offset_seconds, node_timex_estimated_error_seconds, node_timex_maxerror_seconds, node_timex_sync_status. Clock skew matters for cert validation.

nodes.name: node_schedstat_* (~3 metrics, optional collector)
nodes.notes: Examples: node_schedstat_running_seconds_total, node_schedstat_waiting_seconds_total, node_schedstat_timeslices_total. waiting/running ratio = run-queue delay.

nodes.name: kube_pod_* family (~30 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_pod_info, kube_pod_status_phase, kube_pod_status_ready, kube_pod_container_status_running, kube_pod_container_status_waiting, kube_pod_container_status_terminated, kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total, kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason, kube_pod_container_resource_requests, kube_pod_container_resource_limits, kube_pod_status_qos_class.

nodes.name: kube_node_* family (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_node_info, kube_node_status_condition (Ready/MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure/NetworkUnavailable), kube_node_status_capacity, kube_node_status_allocatable, kube_node_spec_taint, kube_node_spec_unschedulable.

nodes.name: kube_deployment_* / replicaset_* / statefulset_* / daemonset_* (~25 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_deployment_status_replicas, kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable, kube_deployment_spec_replicas, kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready, kube_daemonset_status_number_unavailable.

nodes.name: kube_job_* / kube_cronjob_* (~15 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_job_status_failed, kube_job_status_succeeded, kube_job_status_active, kube_job_complete, kube_cronjob_status_active, kube_cronjob_next_schedule_time, kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time.

nodes.name: kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_* (~10 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_current_replicas, kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_desired_replicas, kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_min_replicas, kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_spec_max_replicas, kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_status_condition.

nodes.name: kube_service_* / endpoint_* / ingress_* / networkpolicy_* (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Network sheet.

nodes.name: kube_persistentvolume_* / pvc_* / storageclass_* (full enumeration in Storage sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Storage sheet.

nodes.name: kube_namespace_* / resourcequota / limitrange (~12 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_namespace_status_phase, kube_namespace_labels, kube_resourcequota (per resource, per type=hard/used), kube_limitrange (per resource, per type).

nodes.name: kube_configmap_* / secret_* / serviceaccount_* (~8 metrics)
nodes.notes: Examples: kube_configmap_info, kube_secret_info, kube_secret_type, kube_serviceaccount_info. Sensitive: secret values are NOT exposed, only metadata.

nodes.name: metrics.k8s.io API (resource metrics — 4 fields)
nodes.granularity: Per node, per pod, per container
nodes.notes: Fields: cpu (nanocores), memory (Ki). Backs HPA. Disabled by default in kubeadm; bundled in Minikube/MicroK8s addons; pre-installed in K3s.

nodes.name: custom.metrics.k8s.io / external.metrics.k8s.io (interfaces)
nodes.notes: Empty until an adapter is installed. Backs HPA scaling on custom signals.

nodes.name: Raw /proc and /sys (procfs/sysfs)
nodes.granularity: Per node, per process, per device
nodes.collection_method: Direct file read inside privileged DaemonSet, or node-exporter parses on your behalf
nodes.notes: Files: /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, /proc/diskstats, /proc/net/dev, /proc/net/snmp, /proc/[pid]/*, /proc/pressure/*, /sys/class/net/*, /sys/fs/cgroup/*, /sys/block/*.

nodes.name: cgroup v1/v2 stats (cpu.stat, memory.stat, io.stat, pids.current)
nodes.notes: v2 paths differ from v1. Modern Kubernetes uses cgroup v2 by default. Throttling counters: cpu.stat (nr_throttled, throttled_usec). Memory pressure: memory.pressure.

nodes.name: Pixie auto-instrumented metrics (LET — dozens)
nodes.notes: No code changes — kernel-level capture via kprobes/uprobes. Requires recent kernel; arm64 support evolving.

nodes.name: Kepler power/energy metrics (~15)
nodes.granularity: Per pod, per container, per node
nodes.notes: Examples: kepler_container_joules_total, kepler_container_package_joules_total, kepler_container_dram_joules_total, kepler_container_other_joules_total, kepler_node_package_joules_total. See Cost & Energy sheet.

nodes.name: Cilium / Hubble metrics (full enumeration in Network sheet)
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Network sheet.

nodes.name: OpenCost cost metrics (~20)
nodes.granularity: Per pod, per namespace, per controller
nodes.notes: Examples: opencost_cluster_cpu_cost, opencost_pod_cpu_allocation, opencost_node_total_hourly_cost. See Cost & Energy sheet.

nodes.name: Falco metrics (~6)
nodes.notes: Examples: falco_rules_matches_total, falco_events_total, falco_n_drops, falco_n_drops_buffer, falco_n_evts.

correlation_groups.why: eBPF signal trace; gated on eBPF caps

nodes.name: Container stdout/stderr logs
nodes.notes: Symlinks at /var/log/containers/. Rotated by kubelet (containerLogMaxSize, containerLogMaxFiles). containerd uses CRI log format: '<RFC3339Nano> <stream> <P|F> <log>'.

nodes.name: Previous container logs (post-restart)
nodes.notes: Critical for crash diagnostics. Lost when pod object is deleted or kubelet rotates beyond retention.

nodes.name: kubelet logs
nodes.notes: Structured logging via --logging-format=json. K3s logs to /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/logs by default.

nodes.name: kube-apiserver logs
nodes.notes: In static-pod deployments (kubeadm) → /var/log/pods. In K3s, embedded in k3s-server logs.

nodes.name: kube-scheduler logs
nodes.notes: Scheduling decisions, predicate failures, preemption events.

nodes.name: kube-controller-manager logs
nodes.notes: Controller reconcile loops, leader election, errors.

nodes.name: kube-proxy logs
nodes.notes: iptables/ipvs/nftables sync errors. Cilium kube-proxy replacement obviates this.

nodes.name: etcd logs
nodes.notes: Slow apply, leader changes, snapshot timing. K3s uses embedded SQLite/etcd by default — no separate etcd pod.

nodes.name: CoreDNS logs
nodes.notes: log plugin must be enabled in Corefile for query-level logs.

nodes.name: API server audit logs
nodes.notes: Levels: None, Metadata, Request, RequestResponse. Fields: user.username, user.groups, verb, objectRef, sourceIPs, userAgent, requestReceivedTimestamp, stageTimestamp, responseStatus.code, requestObject, responseObject, annotations.

nodes.name: systemd journal (journald)
nodes.notes: Captures kernel + all systemd units. Critical for kubelet/containerd/network events.

nodes.name: Kernel ring buffer (dmesg)
nodes.notes: OOM killer messages, network driver issues, disk errors, PSI events. Often the first sign of OOMKill cause.

nodes.name: OOM killer messages
nodes.notes: Format: 'Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process <pid> (<comm>) total-vm:<X>kB ...'. Pairs with container_oom_events_total.

nodes.name: containerd logs
nodes.notes: Image pull failures, sandbox creation errors, snapshotter issues.

nodes.name: CRI-O / Docker shim logs
nodes.notes: Dockershim removed in Kubernetes 1.24+. CRI-O standard in OpenShift, available in MicroK8s.

nodes.name: CNI plugin logs
nodes.notes: Pod sandbox creation failures, IPAM exhaustion. Path varies by plugin.

nodes.name: CSI driver logs
nodes.notes: csi-provisioner, csi-attacher, csi-resizer, csi-snapshotter sidecar logs. Critical for PVC binding diagnostics.

nodes.name: Aggregated logs via Fluent Bit / Fluentd / Vector
nodes.notes: Tail /var/log/containers/*.log, enrich with k8s metadata via kubernetes_metadata filter, ship to backend.

nodes.name: Loki query results
nodes.notes: Stores logs as compressed chunks indexed by labels. Patterns: rate({namespace="x"} |= "error" [5m]).

nodes.name: node-problem-detector emissions
nodes.notes: Detects KernelDeadlock, ReadonlyFilesystem, FrequentDockerRestart, FrequentKubeletRestart, FrequentContainerdRestart, NTP issues.

nodes.name: Trivy Operator scan reports
nodes.notes: Findings stored as structured CRs.

nodes.name: Falco event log (separate from metrics)
nodes.collection_method: stdout / file / syslog / HTTP / gRPC / Falco Sidekick
nodes.notes: Fields: priority, rule, output, output_fields (proc.name, container.id, k8s.ns.name, fd.name, evt.type, user.name, etc.).

correlation_groups.why: eBPF signal trace; gated on eBPF caps

nodes.name: Tetragon event log
nodes.notes: Process exec, file open, network connection, capability use. Pod metadata enrichment via Cilium pkg/k8s.

correlation_groups.why: eBPF signal trace; gated on eBPF caps

nodes.name: Tracee event log
nodes.notes: 650+ event IDs covering syscalls, LSM hooks, network, capabilities. CO-RE-based.

correlation_groups.why: eBPF signal trace; gated on eBPF caps

nodes.name: Inspektor Gadget gadget output
nodes.collection_method: kubectl gadget run / kubectl gadget trace
nodes.notes: Gadgets: trace_exec, trace_open, trace_tcpconnect, trace_dns, top_file, top_block, profile_cpu, profile_block.

nodes.name: Pixie data tables (http_events, mysql_events, etc.)
nodes.notes: Tables: http_events, mysql_events, postgres_events, redis_events, dns_events, tcp_drops, jvm_stats, process_stats.

nodes.name: Cilium policy verdict / Hubble L7 flow logs
nodes.collection_method: hubble observe / Hubble UI / cilium monitor
nodes.notes: Records ALLOWED/DENIED for L3/L4/L7 with source/dest pod, port, protocol, verdict, drop_reason.

nodes.name: KubeArmor security logs
nodes.notes: Policy violation events from AppArmor / SELinux / BPF-LSM enforcement.

nodes.name: Pod scheduling events (Scheduled / FailedScheduling)
nodes.notes: Reason=Scheduled (Normal) / FailedScheduling (Warning). Common messages: '0/3 nodes available: 3 Insufficient cpu', 'didn't tolerate taint'.

nodes.name: Image pull events (Pulling / Pulled / Failed / BackOff / ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull)
nodes.notes: Reasons: Pulling, Pulled, Failed, BackOff, InspectFailed, ErrImagePull, ErrImageNeverPull, ImagePullBackOff.

nodes.name: Container lifecycle events (Created / Started / Killing / Preempting / ExceededGracePeriod)
nodes.notes: Reasons: Created, Started, Killing, Preempting, ExceededGracePeriod.

nodes.name: Container failure events (BackOff / CrashLoopBackOff / Error)
nodes.collection_method: kubectl get events / kubectl describe pod
nodes.notes: Reasons: BackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, Error. Always Warning. lastTransitionTime + count fields important.

nodes.name: Probe events (Unhealthy / ProbeWarning)
nodes.notes: Reasons: Unhealthy (liveness/readiness/startup), ProbeWarning. Includes probe type and HTTP code or exec exit.

nodes.name: OOMKilled (OOMKilling)
nodes.notes: Reason=OOMKilling on the Pod. Reflected in pod.status.containerStatuses[].lastState.terminated.reason='OOMKilled' with exitCode=137.

nodes.name: Pod eviction (Evicted)
nodes.notes: Messages: 'The node was low on resource: <signal>'. Signals: memory.available, nodefs.available, imagefs.available, pid.available.

nodes.name: Volume events (FailedMount / FailedAttachVolume / SuccessfulAttachVolume / SuccessfulMountVolume / VolumeResizeSuccessful / VolumeResizeFailed / FileSystemResizeSuccessful)
nodes.notes: Critical for PVC diagnostics. SuccessfulAttachVolume from attach/detach controller; FailedMount from kubelet.

nodes.name: Node lifecycle events (NodeReady / NodeNotReady / NodeHasSufficientMemory / NodeHasNoDiskPressure / NodeHasSufficientPID / RegisteredNode / RemovingNode / DeletingNode)
nodes.notes: Plus pressure reasons: NodeHasMemoryPressure, NodeHasDiskPressure, NodeHasPIDPressure, NodeHasNetworkUnavailable.

nodes.name: Node controller events (NodeNotSchedulable / NodeSchedulable / Starting / Rebooted / TerminatingEvictedPod)
nodes.notes: Includes node deletion controller for pod eviction on tainted/lost nodes.

nodes.name: Deployment / ReplicaSet events (ScalingReplicaSet / SuccessfulCreate / SuccessfulDelete / FailedCreate / DeploymentRollback / DeploymentPaused / DeploymentResumed)
DaemonSet events (FailedDaemonPod / SuccessfulDelete / SuccessfulCreate)
nodes.notes: Often appears when node selector or taint mismatch prevents pod placement.

nodes.name: StatefulSet events (RecreatingFailedPod / SuccessfulCreate / FailedCreate)
nodes.notes: Includes ordinal-aware operations. PVC creation events tied to volumeClaimTemplates.

nodes.name: Job / CronJob events (SuccessfulCreate / SuccessfulDelete / BackoffLimitExceeded / DeadlineExceeded / FailedCreate / MissingJob / SawCompletedJob)
nodes.notes: Reason=BackoffLimitExceeded after spec.backoffLimit retries; DeadlineExceeded after activeDeadlineSeconds.

nodes.name: HPA events (SuccessfulRescale / FailedComputeMetricsReplicas / FailedRescale / FailedGetResourceMetric)
nodes.collection_method: kubectl get events / kubectl describe hpa
nodes.notes: FailedGetResourceMetric typically means metrics-server is missing or pod has no requests.

nodes.name: Endpoints / EndpointSlice events (FailedToCreateEndpoint / FailedToUpdateEndpoint)
nodes.notes: Tied to pod readiness changes. EndpointSlices replace Endpoints for scaling.

nodes.name: PVC / PV provisioning events (ProvisioningSucceeded / ProvisioningFailed / WaitForFirstConsumer / FailedBinding / VolumeFailedDelete / WaitForPodScheduled)
nodes.notes: External provisioner sidecar emits ProvisioningSucceeded/Failed; PV controller emits WaitForFirstConsumer (Late Binding).

nodes.name: Ingress events (Sync / TranslateIngress / FailedToTranslateIngress)
nodes.notes: Reasons differ per controller. Traefik (default in K3s), Nginx-ingress have distinct sets.

nodes.name: Preempting / Preempted (priority preemption)
nodes.notes: PriorityClass-driven preemption emits Preempting on victim pod; Preempted on the new pod.

nodes.name: TaintManagerEviction
nodes.notes: Triggered by NoExecute taint with tolerationSeconds.

nodes.name: PodDisruptionBudget events (NotEnoughHealthyPods)
nodes.notes: Eviction API blocked when PDB violated; emits a 429 + event.

nodes.name: ConfigMap / Secret update propagation events
nodes.notes: Defaults to watch+TTL cache; updates propagate to mounted volumes within ~minute. Subprocess does not auto-restart.

nodes.name: Custom Resource events from operators (operator-defined Reasons)
nodes.notes: E.g., Prometheus operator emits PrometheusRule events; Cert-manager emits Issuing, IssuerNotReady, etc.

nodes.name: node-problem-detector events (KernelDeadlock / ReadonlyFilesystem / DockerHung / FrequentKubeletRestart / FrequentContainerdRestart / NTPProblem)
nodes.notes: Complements native node conditions with kernel/runtime detection.

nodes.name: kube-apiserver request tracing
nodes.notes: Captures admission, authentication, etcd round-trip latencies. Spans labeled with verb, resource, dryRun, code.

nodes.name: kubelet tracing
nodes.notes: Captures runtime ops (RunPodSandbox, CreateContainer, StartContainer, ExecSync, PullImage). Helps trace pod start latency.

nodes.name: etcd tracing
nodes.notes: Sampling-based; useful for slow-query forensics.

nodes.name: Application traces via OpenTelemetry SDK
nodes.notes: Span fields: trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, name, kind, attributes, events, links, status. Auto-instrumentation libraries for Java/Python/Node/.NET/Go.

nodes.name: OpenTelemetry Operator auto-instrumentation injection

nodes.name: Jaeger spans
nodes.notes: Backed by Cassandra/Elasticsearch/Badger. Supports JaegerQL.

nodes.name: Tempo traces
nodes.notes: Object-storage backed; queried via TraceQL. Tightly integrated with Loki and Grafana.

nodes.name: Zipkin spans
nodes.notes: OpenTelemetry can export Zipkin format.

nodes.name: Service-mesh spans (Istio, Linkerd, Cilium Service Mesh)
nodes.notes: Mesh injects trace headers (B3, W3C TraceContext) and emits spans without app code changes.

nodes.name: Pixie auto-traces (HTTP/gRPC/MySQL/Postgres/Redis/Kafka)
nodes.notes: No instrumentation required. Reconstructs full request/response from kernel events.

nodes.name: Hubble L7 flow events with HTTP/gRPC/Kafka decoding
nodes.notes: L7 visibility annotation enables HTTP/Kafka parsing inside the eBPF datapath.

nodes.name: OTel Collector internal pipeline metrics (otelcol_*)

nodes.name: eBPF process trees (Tracee / Tetragon)
nodes.notes: Reconstructs syscall causality (parent-child, capabilities, file/network ops).

nodes.name: Service-mesh access logs (Envoy access log)
nodes.notes: Fields: %START_TIME%, %REQ(:METHOD)%, %REQ(X-REQUEST-ID)%, %RESPONSE_CODE%, %RESPONSE_FLAGS%, %DURATION%, %DOWNSTREAM_REMOTE_ADDRESS%, %UPSTREAM_HOST%.

nodes.name: Pod .status.phase
nodes.notes: Mirrored as kube_pod_status_phase by kube-state-metrics.

nodes.name: Pod .status.conditions (PodScheduled / ContainersReady / Initialized / Ready / DisruptionTarget)

nodes.name: Pod .status.qosClass

nodes.name: Pod .status.podIPs / hostIP / podIP

nodes.name: Node .status.conditions (Ready / MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure / NetworkUnavailable)

nodes.name: Node .status.capacity / .status.allocatable (cpu, memory, pods, ephemeral-storage, hugepages-*, GPU)
nodes.notes: Allocatable = capacity − system-reserved − kube-reserved − eviction-hard.

nodes.name: Node .status.nodeInfo (OS, kernel, container runtime, kubelet, kube-proxy, machineID, bootID)
nodes.notes: Useful for fleet hygiene / version drift.

nodes.name: Node .status.images (cached images)
nodes.notes: Helps detect image-bloat → imagefs.available pressure.

nodes.name: Node .status.volumesAttached / .status.volumesInUse
nodes.notes: Expected vs actual attachment state. Drift = stuck attach/detach.

nodes.name: Deployment .status (replicas, readyReplicas, updatedReplicas, availableReplicas, unavailableReplicas, conditions)
nodes.notes: Conditions: Available, Progressing, ReplicaFailure.

nodes.name: ReplicaSet / DaemonSet / StatefulSet status
nodes.notes: DaemonSet adds desiredNumberScheduled, currentNumberScheduled, numberMisscheduled, numberAvailable, numberUnavailable. StatefulSet adds currentRevision, updateRevision.

nodes.name: Job / CronJob status (active, succeeded, failed, conditions, lastScheduleTime)
nodes.notes: Job conditions: Complete, Failed, Suspended.

nodes.name: HPA .status (currentReplicas, desiredReplicas, currentMetrics, conditions: AbleToScale, ScalingActive, ScalingLimited)
nodes.notes: currentMetrics shows the actual values used in the most recent decision.

nodes.name: Service .spec.type / .spec.clusterIP / .spec.externalIPs / .status.loadBalancer.ingress
nodes.notes: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName.

nodes.name: EndpointSlice (.endpoints[], .ports[], .addressType IPv4/IPv6/FQDN)
nodes.notes: Replaces Endpoints (still kept). Each slice up to 100 endpoints by default.

nodes.name: Ingress / IngressClass status
nodes.notes: loadBalancer.ingress[] populated by controller.

nodes.name: PersistentVolume .status.phase (Pending/Available/Bound/Released/Failed) + .spec.capacity / .spec.csi
nodes.notes: Cross-reference Storage sheet for kube_persistentvolume_* metric mirrors.

nodes.name: PersistentVolumeClaim .status.phase (Pending/Bound/Lost) + .status.capacity + .status.conditions (Resizing, FileSystemResizePending)

nodes.name: VolumeAttachment .status (attached, attachError, detachError, attachmentMetadata)
nodes.notes: Indicates CSI ControllerPublishVolume completion.

nodes.name: CSIDriver / CSINode (driver capabilities, allocatable inline volumes, NodeID mappings)
nodes.notes: podInfoOnMount, fsGroupPolicy, requiresRepublish, storageCapacity flags drive scheduling/mount behavior.

nodes.name: ResourceQuota .status (hard, used)
nodes.notes: Hits ratio approaching 1.0 = quota exhaustion incoming.

nodes.name: LimitRange .spec
nodes.notes: Default/min/max per Pod/Container/PVC.

nodes.name: NetworkPolicy .spec (podSelector, ingress, egress, policyTypes)
nodes.notes: Enforcement requires CNI support (Calico, Cilium).

nodes.name: RBAC: Role / ClusterRole / RoleBinding / ClusterRoleBinding
nodes.notes: kube-state-metrics exposes kube_role_*, kube_clusterrole_*, kube_rolebinding_*, kube_clusterrolebinding_*.

nodes.name: ServiceAccount + bound Secrets / projected tokens
nodes.notes: Bound Service Account Tokens (TokenRequest API) since 1.22+ replace static Secrets.

nodes.name: PodSecurity admission (PSA) namespace labels
nodes.notes: Replaces deprecated PodSecurityPolicy (PSP).

nodes.name: ConfigMap / Secret data and metadata.resourceVersion
nodes.notes: Secret types: Opaque, kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson, kubernetes.io/tls, etc.

nodes.name: Lease objects (kube-node-lease, leader election leases)
nodes.notes: Node heartbeat → kube-node-lease/<node>. Leases mainly used for leader election since 1.14.

nodes.name: CRDs and Custom Resources
nodes.notes: Operators populate .status fields; kube-state-metrics CR support via Custom Resource State.

nodes.name: APIService aggregation status
nodes.notes: Available condition false = aggregated API (e.g., metrics-server) unhealthy.

nodes.name: /healthz, /readyz, /livez endpoints + subchecks
nodes.notes: Fine-grained: /readyz/poststarthook/<name>, /livez/etcd, /livez/ping. Used by liveness probes.

nodes.description: The Kubernetes cluster as a whole.
K8s namespace; scope for most workload signals.
Kubelet host. Host network + host PID namespace are anchored here.
K8s Pod; primary join key (k8s.pod.uid is strongest cross-modal anchor).
Container in a pod; a leaf cgroup. cAdvisor 'container_*' attaches here.
Init container (lifecycle and metric semantics differ from sidecar/main).
Debug container injected at runtime (kubectl debug).
Cgroup node in the kubepods.slice tree (root → QoS → pod → container).
Network namespace owning veth/eth0; pod-netns ≠ host-netns.
Network interface (veth, cni0, cilium_host, eth0, lo).
Namespace-scoped PVC binding a Pod to a PV.
Provisioner config for dynamic PVC binding.
EndpointSlice / Endpoints; the pod-set behind a Service.
etcd member (kubeadm cluster) or k3s embedded SQLite/etcd.
DNS zone served or forwarded by CoreDNS.
Process inside a container (eBPF observers attach here).
Network policy / SCC / OPA / Kyverno decision record.
RAPL energy domain (package/dram/uncore/psys) on a node.
cAdvisor (embedded in kubelet, exposes container_* metrics)
Fluent Bit (log shipper with kubernetes filter)
Go pprof endpoints (/debug/pprof on Go components)
CSI driver + sidecars (external-attacher, external-provisioner, external-resizer, external-snapshotter, external-health-monitor)
Linux kernel (dmesg, /proc, /sys, perf events, cgroup files)
Generic CRI runtime (containerd/CRI-O) — for CRI events stream
Linux kernel ≥ 4.18 (eBPF kprobes, basic BCC/Falco kernel module).
Linux kernel ≥ 5.8 (CO-RE, BTF, CAP_BPF + CAP_PERFMON split).
Kernel built with CONFIG_PSI=y (and on some distros psi=1 boot param).
kube-apiserver --tracing-config-file with samplingRatePerMillion + reachable OTLP endpoint.
kube-apiserver audit policy YAML configured + backend (file/webhook).
CSI driver (NOT local-path/hostPath) — required for trustworthy per-PVC kubelet_volume_stats_*.
CSI driver supports volume health monitoring + External Health Monitor controller deployed.
[metrics] address set in /etc/containerd/config.toml AND io.containerd.server.v1.metrics plugin enabled.
node-exporter DaemonSet with hostPID + hostNetwork + /proc + /sys mounts.
cAdvisor ≥ v0.43 (cgroupv2 CPU+memory emission complete; kubernetes#106393).
Hubble enabled within Cilium (hubble.enabled=true, metrics list configured).
Kepler deployed AND power source accessible (RAPL via intel-rapl, or HWMon, or Redfish, or NVML, or ML estimator).
Istio control plane + sidecars present (istio_*, envoy_*).
Falco running with kernel-module or modern_ebpf or legacy ebpf driver.
Tracee deployed (CO-RE+BTF preferred; legacy mode for older kernels).
Pixie deployed (PEM agents on each node, requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN for some tables).
Parca server + Parca Agent (eBPF + DWARF unwinder).
OTel Collector with k8sattributesprocessor + EmitV1K8sConventions feature gate.
Fluent Bit / Fluentd / Vector / Promtail with kubernetes filter for log enrichment.
API Priority and Fairness enabled (--enable-priority-and-fairness=true; default modern).
etcd metrics endpoint reachable (kubeadm: by default; k3s: --etcd-expose-metrics=true; managed K8s: NOT exposed).
/dev/kmsg or journalctl -k accessible to log shipper.
kube-proxy running (NOT replaced by Cilium kpr).
K8s ≥1.24 + non-Docker runtime: documented set of container_fs_* metrics absent (kubernetes/website docs); workaround = standalone cAdvisor or rely on /stats/summary.
k3s with default SQLite datastore: NO etcd_* metrics. Switch with --cluster-init for embedded etcd.
k3s default StorageClass = local-path (Rancher local-path-provisioner) → kubelet_volume_stats_* report host partition, not per-PVC.
k3s consolidates apiserver/scheduler/cm/kube-proxy/kubelet in one process — scraping multiple endpoints duplicates.
microk8s ≥1.21 consolidates components in kubelite; component-specific metric endpoints differ from kubeadm.
EKS does NOT expose scheduler / controller-manager metrics; etcd metrics never exposed.
GKE Cloud Monitoring renames metrics to prometheus.googleapis.com/<orig>/<gauge|counter|histogram>.
AKS exposes a curated subset of control-plane metrics via Azure Monitor managed Prometheus.
OpenShift ≥4.12 default: OVN-Kubernetes (ovnkube_*, ovn_controller_*) replaces SDN (openshift_sdn_*).
OpenShift Cluster Monitoring Operator pre-deploys Prometheus/Thanos/Alertmanager; user-defined-project monitoring is opt-in.
kube-state-metrics v1→v2: kube_hpa_* → kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_*; many labels snake_cased; deprecated metrics removed.
cAdvisor < v0.43 emits zero CPU/memory metrics on cgroupv2 nodes (kubernetes#106393).
cgroupv2 root cgroup has no memory.current; cAdvisor falls back to /proc/meminfo, overestimating root by 250–750 MiB (kubernetes#118916). kubectl top node affected; pod stats not.
Kubernetes v1.31 put cgroupv1 in maintenance mode; security fixes only.
CoreDNS < 1.8.7: rcode label mislabeling (NXDOMAIN reported as NOERROR; coredns#5125, #4726).
kubelet does not enforce limits.ephemeral-storage / emptyDir.sizeLimit on some k3s configurations (user lab, Phase 5 §10.2).
Kubelet PSI feature gate: alpha 1.31, beta 1.34, GA 1.36 (per upstream docs).

nodes.label: Host-netns TCP retrans counter does not see pod-netns retrans
nodes.evidence: User confirmed in lab (Phase 6 P1: 5% loss on currencyservice egress → +170% relative bump but +0.044/s absolute, far below detection threshold). Linux /proc/net is per-netns; kubernetes#39198 requesting host_network=true label.
nodes.implication: Every node-level retrans alert silently misses pod-network problems. Pair with container_network_*_packets_dropped_* per pod-netns.

nodes.label: Local-path PVC stats report host filesystem
nodes.condition: StorageClass = local-path or hostPath (e.g., k3s default).
nodes.evidence: User confirmed; documented kubelet stats provider behavior; local-path-provisioner README. Workaround: per-PV partitioning, real CSI driver, or external lp-exporter sidecar.
nodes.implication: All PVC-stats signals collapse to one host-FS reading; cannot disambiguate per-volume usage.

nodes.label: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total may be absent
nodes.condition: Some cAdvisor builds + cgroupv2; some kube-prometheus-stack drop configs; user lab k3s+kernel 6.17.
nodes.evidence: cadvisor#3062, dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes#161; *_throttled_periods_total is reliably present.
nodes.implication: Use throttle_ratio = throttled_periods/periods as the canonical throttle signal.

nodes.label: container_fs_* on overlayfs double-counts layers
nodes.condition: Container runtime uses overlayfs (containerd default) on some kernels.
nodes.evidence: Kubernetes website documents container_fs_* absent set on non-Docker runtimes after dockershim removal.
nodes.implication: For ephemeral-storage usage prefer kubelet /stats/summary fs.usedBytes.

nodes.label: imagefs metrics inflated by GC
nodes.condition: Image GC operates in chunks (whole layers).
nodes.evidence: kubelet imageGC behavior produces sawtooth unrelated to workload.
nodes.implication: Treat imagefs trends as discontinuous; alert on imagefs.used > evictionHard threshold rather than rate-of-change.

nodes.label: Conntrack near-limit silent drops
nodes.condition: nf_conntrack_count / nf_conntrack_max ≥ 0.75; no drop counter emitted.
nodes.evidence: Kernel emits 'nf_conntrack: table full' to dmesg without a Prometheus counter.
nodes.implication: Detection requires utilization ratio + dmesg scrape; with Cilium kpr use cilium_bpf_map_pressure on cilium_ct_*.

nodes.label: TIME_WAIT / port exhaustion invisible to standard k8s metrics
nodes.evidence: Only node-exporter node_sockstat_TCP_tw and /proc/net/sockstat observe it.
nodes.implication: Add node-exporter sockstat collector explicitly when SNAT/port-bursty workloads run on the cluster.

nodes.label: Probe success during slow start is a false negative
nodes.condition: App returns probe response while unable to do real work.
nodes.evidence: User Phase 4-6 lab: probes can succeed while application is barely making progress.
nodes.implication: Probe-success ≠ workload functioning. See PROBE_CASCADE meta-gotcha.

nodes.label: kubelet_volume_stats_* race on PVC remount
nodes.evidence: kubelet stats provider polls volumes asynchronously.
nodes.implication: Treat zero/stale volume stats for ~60s after pod restart as unobservable, not as 'no usage'.

nodes.label: Init container metrics persist after init completion
nodes.evidence: kubelet should not report metrics from init containers issue.
nodes.implication: De-dup by container.name and exclude init containers explicitly.

nodes.label: cAdvisor metric staleness on container restart
nodes.condition: Window of ≤1 PLEG relist interval (default 1s, longer under load).
nodes.evidence: PLEG relist drives cAdvisor refresh; terminated containers continue emitting briefly.
nodes.implication: Brief duplication of restart counters; rate windows ≥30s smooth this.

nodes.label: kube-state-metrics scrape race
nodes.evidence: KSM rebuilds full view per scrape.
nodes.implication: Use Events as authoritative ledger for object lifecycles; never KSM alone.

nodes.label: Pod-IP-based OTel association breaks in service mesh
nodes.condition: mTLS proxy is the connection peer for k8sattributesprocessor.
nodes.evidence: OTel SemConv non-normative guide.
nodes.implication: Inject k8s.pod.uid via downward API rather than relying on IP-based association.

nodes.label: Log rotation skews log-derived metrics
nodes.evidence: Documented Fluent Bit tail behavior around inode change.
nodes.implication: Allow hysteresis on log-derived counters; prefer kubernetes journal log driver where stable.

nodes.label: cgroupv2 root cgroup memory overestimated
nodes.evidence: kubernetes#118916; cAdvisor falls back to /proc/meminfo (free-based) which overestimates by 250–750 MiB.
nodes.implication: kubectl top node affected; pod stats not. Don't rely on root-cgroup memory as ground truth.

nodes.label: emptyDir.sizeLimit / ephemeral-storage limit may not be enforced
nodes.evidence: User wrote 1 GiB to a 512Mi-capped emptyDir successfully.
nodes.implication: Cannot trust kubelet eviction-manager to limit ephemeral-storage; need defense in depth (memory cgroup + fio --size cap + host-fs guardrail).

nodes.label: gRPC connection multiplexing masks intermittent network faults
nodes.evidence: User lab Phase 6 P1 + L1: workload-side error metrics flat under 5% loss / 50ms latency due to keepalive + multiplexing.
nodes.implication: Network-layer counters are PRIMARY, not corroborating. A fault may be invisible at apiserver / 5xx layer while cilium_drop_count_total / TCPSynRetrans rise.

nodes.label: Probe response is on critical path of every fault (probe-cascade meta-gotcha)
nodes.evidence: User Phase 4 trial T4 + Phase 4.5 trial B + Phase 6 (latent in every L2 trial).
nodes.implication: Disruptions in CPU / memory / IO / network can manifest as 'probe failure → restart' with no in-app fault. Treat every restart as hop-2 of a possibly different root cause.

nodes.label: CoreDNS <1.8.7 rcode mislabeling
nodes.evidence: coredns#5125, coredns#4726.
nodes.implication: NXDOMAIN counted as NOERROR; do not trust per-rcode counts on older CoreDNS.

nodes.label: System OOM ≠ cgroup OOM
nodes.evidence: node_vmstat_oom_kill increments only on system OOM; cgroup OOM increments only memory.events oom_kill + container_oom_events_total.
nodes.implication: Distinguish phenomena: system OOM may kill any process (potentially below limit); cgroup OOM kills processes in over-limit cgroup.

nodes.label: Some container_fs_* metrics absent on non-Docker runtimes
nodes.evidence: Kubernetes website (Check whether dockershim removal affects you).
nodes.implication: Deploy cAdvisor as standalone DaemonSet to recover full set, or rely on /stats/summary.

nodes.label: Container working-set memory
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1: memory.usage_in_bytes − inactive_file (memory.stat). cgroup_v2: memory.current − inactive_file. This is the metric the OOM-killer compares to memory.max.

nodes.label: Container RSS
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 total_rss vs cgroup_v2 anon. RSS rising while cache stable is a memory-leak signature.

nodes.label: Container memory cache
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 total_cache vs cgroup_v2 file (memory.stat).

nodes.label: Container memory usage (raw)
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 memory.usage_in_bytes vs cgroup_v2 memory.current. ≠ working_set.

nodes.label: Container memory page faults
nodes.notes: pgfault vs pgmajfault from memory.stat.

nodes.label: Container OOM-kill events
nodes.notes: cgroup_v2 memory.events oom_kill ≡ cgroup_v1 memory.oom_control oom_kill.

nodes.label: Container CPU time
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 cpuacct.usage ≡ cgroup_v2 cpu.stat usage_usec.

nodes.label: Container CPU throttling
nodes.notes: throttle_ratio = throttled_periods/periods is the robust derivation; *_seconds_total may be absent on some kernel/cgroup combos (cadvisor#3062, k3s+6.17 lab).

nodes.label: Container CPU quota / period
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 cpu.cfs_quota_us+cpu.cfs_period_us ≡ cgroup_v2 single file cpu.max.

nodes.label: Container memory limit
nodes.notes: cgroup_v1 memory.limit_in_bytes ≡ cgroup_v2 memory.max.

nodes.label: Container filesystem usage
nodes.notes: On overlayfs may double-count layers; on emptyDir reports tmpfs; on local-path PVC reports underlying partition.

nodes.label: PVC capacity / availability / used
nodes.notes: With local-path provisioner, all members report the underlying host partition rather than per-PVC.

nodes.label: PVC health (volume health monitoring)
nodes.notes: Alpha; requires CSI driver + External Health Monitor controller + CSIVolumeHealth feature gate.

nodes.label: Pod phase
nodes.notes: State + metric mirror of Pod .status.phase enum.

nodes.label: Node conditions
nodes.notes: Ready / MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure / NetworkUnavailable.

nodes.label: Last termination reason
nodes.notes: OOMKilled / Error / Completed / ContainerCannotRun. Critical for restart forensics.

nodes.label: CPU pressure (PSI)
nodes.notes: some=waiting, full=stalled. Requires kernel ≥4.20 + CONFIG_PSI=y + cgroupv2.

nodes.label: DNS response codes
nodes.notes: coredns_dns_response_rcode_count_total deprecated; coredns_dns_responses_total is current. CoreDNS <1.8.7 mislabels NXDOMAIN as NOERROR (coredns#5125).

nodes.label: Host-netns TCP retrans
nodes.notes: HOST netns only — does NOT see pod-netns retransmissions (user's confirmed lab finding).

nodes.label: Per-pod-netns packet drops
nodes.notes: NOT equivalent to host-netns retrans counters; complementary observer in the pod's netns.

nodes.label: etcd disk latency
nodes.notes: p99 fsync >10ms is the canonical etcd-slow signal; cluster-wide apiserver latency is downstream.

nodes.label: API server request latency
nodes.notes: p99 by verb/resource. Downstream of etcd disk; upstream of every controller.

nodes.label: kube-proxy iptables sync
nodes.notes: Disjoint from Cilium kpr — Cilium replaces this stack and emits cilium_bpf_map_pressure / cilium_endpoint_* instead.

nodes.label: Probe result
nodes.notes: Probe success during slow start is a known false-negative; meta-gotcha.

nodes.label: PLEG relist
nodes.notes: PLEG hangs are a frequent NodeNotReady root cause.

nodes.label: Conntrack table
nodes.notes: Near-limit silent drops have NO Prometheus drop counter; require dmesg correlation.

nodes.label: Energy / power
nodes.notes: Requires RAPL/HWMon/Redfish/NVML access; bare-metal preferred.

nodes.label: OOM kill (cgroup-level)
signals: dmesg.*Killed process|kernel.* Memory cgroup out of memory
eBPF signal trace; gated on eBPF caps
